correction: Appended a proof-independent planar radial-homotopy diagram with an exterior point x, interior point y, their unit normalisations, included endpoints, excluded origin and a fixed sphere point. diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: P=R^n minus {0}; H:P x [0,1] -> P from the Statement; rho:P -> S^(n-1) from lem-radial-normalisation-is-continuous. The illustration is explicitly n=2, with S^1 the unit circle under def-euclidean-spheres-and-closed-balls.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: For the exterior point x at polar (30 degrees,2.2), rho(x) is exactly polar (30 degrees,1). For y=(-0.3,-0.4), norm(y)=0.5 and rho(y)=(-0.6,-0.8) has norm 1. Both arrows go from the chosen point to its normalisation.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The Statement formula expands to H(z,t)=(1-t)z+t rho(z), so both straight segments are the exact trajectories, with t=0 initial and t=1 terminal as in proof step 1.3.

diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Both ends of both motion segments are included; 0 is excluded; s=(0,1) is fixed for every t; all unit-sphere points are fixed, not merely the marked s.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Proof step 1.1 gives a strictly positive radial coefficient, and step 2.1 excludes 0 along the whole trajectory. Step 1.3 and the norm-one sphere definition give H(s,t)=s. Filled dots mark the four included motion endpoints and fixed s; an unfilled ring marks only the excluded origin.

diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: The planar circle is not asserted to represent S^0 for n=1. No commutativity, extra maps, or continuity conclusions are inferred from the figure.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Caption expressly identifies the n=2 picture and the n=1 two-point sphere; the original rigorous proof remains untouched and independent.
